/*DeliveryAddress.doQueryUserDelivery*/
SELECT 'DEFAULT_DA' AS DA_NUMBER , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS REC_USER_NAME , GETDEPTNAME(USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.COMPANY_CODE, USMT.DEPT, ${session.LANGUAGE}) DEPT_NAME , PLNT.ZIP_CODE , PLNT.ADDRESS_LOC , PLNT.ADDRESS_LOC_TEXT , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 , 'true' AS SELECT_USER_ADDR , 'false' AS SELECT_NEW_ADDR FROM SUSMT USMT JOIN SPLNT PLNT ON (USMT.HOUSE_CODE = PLNT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = PLNT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.PLANT_CODE = PLNT.PLANT_CODE) JOIN SADDR ADDR ON (USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER') WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.USER_ID = ${session.ID}

/*DeliveryAddress.doQueryDeliveryAddress*/
SELECT DA_NUMBER , REC_USER_NAME , DEPT_NAME , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS_LOC , ADDRESS_LOC_TEXT , PHONE_NO1 , PHONE_NO2 FROM SDLAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DA_NUMBER = ${DA_NUMBER} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N'

/*DeliveryAddress.doQuery*/
SELECT DA_NUMBER , REC_USER_NAME , DEPT_NAME , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS_LOC , ADDRESS_LOC_TEXT , PHONE_NO1 , PHONE_NO2 FROM SDLAD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC, CHANGE_TIME DESC
